statement-execution-processor.statement: select USERNAME as USER_NAME, case when ACCOUNT_STATUS like '%EXPIRED%' then 'Y' else 'N' end as IS_EXPIRED, case when ACCOUNT_STATUS like '%LOCKED%' then 'Y' else 'N' end as IS_LOCKED from DBA_USERS
select USERNAME as USER_NAME, 'N' as IS_EXPIRED, 'N' as IS_LOCKED from ALL_USERS
select distinct ROLE as ROLE_NAME from DBA_ROLES order by ROLE
select distinct GRANTED_ROLE as ROLE_NAME from [PREFIX]_ROLE_PRIVS order by GRANTED_ROLE

select rp.GRANTEE as USER_NAME, rp.GRANTED_ROLE as GRANTED_ROLE_NAME, decode(rp.ADMIN_OPTION, 'YES', 'Y', 'N') as IS_ADMIN_OPTION, decode(rp.DEFAULT_ROLE, 'YES', 'Y', 'N') as IS_DEFAULT_ROLE from DBA_ROLE_PRIVS rp, DBA_USERS u where rp.GRANTEE = u.USERNAME order by rp.GRANTEE, rp.GRANTED_ROLE asc

select rp.USERNAME as USER_NAME, rp.GRANTED_ROLE as GRANTED_ROLE_NAME, decode(rp.ADMIN_OPTION, 'YES', 'Y', 'N') as IS_ADMIN_OPTION, decode(rp.DEFAULT_ROLE, 'YES', 'Y', 'N') as IS_DEFAULT_ROLE from USER_ROLE_PRIVS rp where rp.USERNAME = USER order by rp.GRANTED_ROLE asc

select rp.GRANTEE as ROLE_NAME, rp.GRANTED_ROLE as GRANTED_ROLE_NAME, decode(rp.ADMIN_OPTION, 'YES', 'Y', 'N') as IS_ADMIN_OPTION, decode(rp.DEFAULT_ROLE, 'YES', 'Y', 'N') as IS_DEFAULT_ROLE from DBA_ROLE_PRIVS rp, DBA_ROLES r where rp.GRANTEE = r.ROLE order by rp.GRANTEE, rp.GRANTED_ROLE asc
select distinct PRIVILEGE as PRIVILEGE_NAME from [PREFIX]_SYS_PRIVS

select sp.GRANTEE as USER_NAME, sp.PRIVILEGE as GRANTED_PRIVILEGE_NAME, decode(sp.ADMIN_OPTION, 'YES', 'Y', 'N') as IS_ADMIN_OPTION from DBA_SYS_PRIVS sp, [PREFIX]_USERS u where sp.GRANTEE = u.USERNAME order by sp.GRANTEE, sp.PRIVILEGE asc

select sp.username as USER_NAME, sp.PRIVILEGE as GRANTED_PRIVILEGE_NAME, decode(sp.ADMIN_OPTION, 'YES', 'Y', 'N') as IS_ADMIN_OPTION from USER_SYS_PRIVS sp where sp.USERNAME = USER order by sp.PRIVILEGE asc

select sp.GRANTEE as ROLE_NAME, sp.PRIVILEGE as GRANTED_PRIVILEGE_NAME, sp.ADMIN_OPTION as IS_ADMIN_OPTION from DBA_SYS_PRIVS sp, DBA_ROLES r where sp.GRANTEE = r.ROLE order by sp.GRANTEE, sp.PRIVILEGE asc

select VALUE as CHARSET_NAME, UTL_I18N.MAP_CHARSET(VALUE) as DISPLAY_NAME, DECODE(ISDEPRECATED, 'TRUE', 'Y', 'N') as IS_DEPRECATED, -1 as MAX_LENGTH from V$NLS_VALID_VALUES where PARAMETER = 'CHARACTERSET'

select u.USERNAME as SCHEMA_NAME, 'N' as IS_PUBLIC, u.ORACLE_MAINTAINED as IS_SYSTEM, 'N' as IS_EMPTY from DBA_USERS u union all select 'PUBLIC', 'Y' as IS_PUBLIC, 'Y' as IS_SYSTEM, 'N' as IS_EMPTY from DUAL

select u.USERNAME as SCHEMA_NAME, 'N' as IS_PUBLIC, decode(u.USERNAME, 'SYS', 'Y', 'SYSTEM', 'Y', 'N') as IS_SYSTEM, 'N' as IS_EMPTY from DBA_USERS u union all select 'PUBLIC', 'Y' as IS_PUBLIC, 'Y' as IS_SYSTEM, 'N' as IS_EMPTY from DUAL

with DBN_OBJECTS as (select distinct u.NAME from SYS.OBJ$ o, SYS.USER$ u where o.OWNER# = u.USER#) select u.USERNAME as SCHEMA_NAME, 'N' as IS_PUBLIC, decode(u.USERNAME, 'SYS', 'Y', 'SYSTEM', 'Y', 'N') as IS_SYSTEM, decode(o.NAME, null, 'Y', 'N') as IS_EMPTY from [PREFIX]_USERS u left join DBN_OBJECTS o on o.NAME = u.USERNAME union all select 'PUBLIC', 'Y' as IS_PUBLIC, 'Y' as IS_SYSTEM, 'N' as IS_EMPTY from DUAL

select u.USERNAME as SCHEMA_NAME, 'N' as IS_PUBLIC, decode(u.USERNAME, 'SYS', 'Y', 'SYSTEM', 'Y', 'N') as IS_SYSTEM, case when exists (select 1 from [PREFIX]_OBJECTS o where o.OWNER = u.USERNAME and rownum = 1) then 'N' else 'Y' end as IS_EMPTY from [PREFIX]_USERS u union all( select 'PUBLIC', 'Y' as IS_PUBLIC, 'Y' as IS_SYSTEM, 'N' as IS_EMPTY from DUAL)
select CLUSTER_NAME from [PREFIX]_CLUSTERS where OWNER = {#0} order by CLUSTER_NAME asc

select CREDENTIAL_NAME, case when USERNAME like 'ocid1.user.oc1.%' then 'OCI' when LOWER(USERNAME) = 'access_token' then 'TOKEN' else 'PASSWORD' end as CREDENTIAL_TYPE, USERNAME as USER_NAME, JSON_VALUE(comments, '$.comments') as COMMENTS, DECODE(ENABLED, 'TRUE', 'Y', 'N') as IS_ENABLED from [PREFIX]_CREDENTIALS d where OWNER = {#0} order by CREDENTIAL_NAME asc

select p.PROFILE_NAME, DECODE(STATUS, 'ENABLED', 'Y', 'N') as IS_ENABLED, DECODE(pa.CONVERSATION, 'true', 'Y', 'N') as IS_CONVERSATION, TO_CHAR(p.DESCRIPTION) AS DESCRIPTION, pa.PROVIDER, pa.MODEL, pa.TEMPERATURE, REGEXP_REPLACE(pa.CREDENTIAL_NAME, '^"(.*)"$', '\1') as CREDENTIAL_NAME, pa.OBJECT_LIST, pa.REGION, pa.OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID, pa.OCI_ENDPOINT_ID, pa.OCI_RUNTIME_TYPE, pa.OCI_API_FORMAT from ( select PROFILE_ID, PROFILE_NAME, ATTRIBUTE_NAME, ATTRIBUTE_VALUE from DBA_CLOUD_AI_PROFILE_ATTRIBUTES ) pivot ( MAX(TO_CHAR(ATTRIBUTE_VALUE)) for ATTRIBUTE_NAME in ( 'provider' AS PROVIDER, 'model' AS MODEL, 'temperature' AS TEMPERATURE, 'credential_name' AS CREDENTIAL_NAME, 'conversation' AS CONVERSATION, 'object_list' AS OBJECT_LIST, 'region' AS REGION, 'oci_compartment_id' AS OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID, 'oci_endpoint_id' AS OCI_ENDPOINT_ID, 'oci_runtimetype' AS OCI_RUNTIME_TYPE, 'oci_apiformat' AS OCI_API_FORMAT ) ) pa join DBA_CLOUD_AI_PROFILES p on p.PROFILE_ID = pa.PROFILE_ID where p.OWNER = {#0} order by pa.PROFILE_NAME asc

select p.PROFILE_NAME, DECODE(STATUS, 'ENABLED', 'Y', 'N') as IS_ENABLED, DECODE(pa.CONVERSATION, 'true', 'Y', 'N') as IS_CONVERSATION, TO_CHAR(p.DESCRIPTION) AS DESCRIPTION, pa.PROVIDER, pa.MODEL, pa.TEMPERATURE, REGEXP_REPLACE(pa.CREDENTIAL_NAME, '^"(.*)"$', '\1') as CREDENTIAL_NAME, pa.OBJECT_LIST, pa.REGION, pa.OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID, pa.OCI_ENDPOINT_ID, pa.OCI_RUNTIME_TYPE, pa.OCI_API_FORMAT from ( select PROFILE_ID, PROFILE_NAME, ATTRIBUTE_NAME, ATTRIBUTE_VALUE from USER_CLOUD_AI_PROFILE_ATTRIBUTES ) pivot ( MAX(TO_CHAR(ATTRIBUTE_VALUE)) for ATTRIBUTE_NAME in ( 'provider' AS PROVIDER, 'model' AS MODEL, 'temperature' AS TEMPERATURE, 'credential_name' AS CREDENTIAL_NAME, 'conversation' AS CONVERSATION, 'object_list' AS OBJECT_LIST, 'region' AS REGION, 'oci_compartment_id' AS OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID, 'oci_endpoint_id' AS OCI_ENDPOINT_ID, 'oci_runtimetype' AS OCI_RUNTIME_TYPE, 'oci_apiformat' AS OCI_API_FORMAT ) ) pa join USER_CLOUD_AI_PROFILES p on p.PROFILE_ID = pa.PROFILE_ID join USER_USERS uu ON uu.USERNAME = {#0} order by pa.PROFILE_NAME asc

select null as PROFILE_NAME, null as IS_ENABLED, null as IS_CONVERSATION, null as DESCRIPTION, null as PROVIDER, null as MODEL, null as TEMPERATURE, null as CREDENTIAL_NAME, null as OBJECT_LIST, null as REGION, null as OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID, null as OCI_ENDPOINT_ID, null as OCI_RUNTIME_TIME, null as OCI_API_FORMAT from DUAL where 1 = 2

select MODEL_NAME, MINING_FUNCTION, ALGORITHM, ALGORITHM_TYPE, MODEL_SIZE, DECODE(PARTITIONED, 'YES', 'Y', 'N') as PARTITIONED, DECODE(EXTERNAL_DATA, 'YES', 'Y', 'N') as EXTERNAL_DATA, DECODE(INMEMORY, 'YES', 'Y', 'N') as INMEMORY from [PREFIX]_MINING_MODELS where OWNER = {#0} order by MODEL_NAME asc

select MODEL_NAME, MINING_FUNCTION, ALGORITHM, ALGORITHM_TYPE, MODEL_SIZE, DECODE(PARTITIONED, 'YES', 'Y', 'N') as PARTITIONED, DECODE(EXTERNAL_DATA, 'YES', 'Y', 'N') as EXTERNAL_DATA, DECODE(INMEMORY, 'YES', 'Y', 'N') as INMEMORY from USER_MINING_MODELS where USER = {#0} order by MODEL_NAME asc
select null as MODEL_NAME, null as MINING_FUNCTION, null as ALGORITHM, null as ALGORITHM_TYPE, null as MODEL_SIZE, 'N' as PARTITIONED, 'N' as EXTERNAL_DATA, 'N' as INMEMORY from DUAL where 1 = 2

select t.TABLE_NAME, null as COMMENTS, t.TEMPORARY as IS_TEMPORARY from [PREFIX]_ALL_TABLES t where t.OWNER = {#0} and not exists (SELECT 1 from [PREFIX]_MVIEWS mv where mv.OWNER = t.owner and mv.MVIEW_NAME = t.TABLE_NAME) order by t.TABLE_NAME asc

select v.VIEW_NAME, v.VIEW_TYPE_OWNER, v.VIEW_TYPE, null as COMMENTS, 'N' as IS_SYSTEM_VIEW, o.EDITIONABLE as IS_EDITIONABLE from [PREFIX]_VIEWS v inner join [PREFIX]_OBJECTS o on o.OWNER = v.OWNER and o.OBJECT_NAME = v.VIEW_NAME left join [PREFIX]_JSON_DUALITY_VIEWS jv on jv.VIEW_OWNER = v.OWNER and jv.VIEW_NAME = v.VIEW_NAME where v.OWNER = {#0} and jv.VIEW_NAME is null order by v.VIEW_NAME asc

select v.VIEW_NAME, v.VIEW_TYPE_OWNER, v.VIEW_TYPE, null as COMMENTS, 'N' as IS_SYSTEM_VIEW, o.EDITIONABLE as IS_EDITIONABLE from [PREFIX]_VIEWS v inner join [PREFIX]_OBJECTS o on o.OWNER = v.OWNER and o.OBJECT_NAME = v.VIEW_NAME where v.OWNER = {#0} and v.DUALITY_VIEW != 'YES' order by v.VIEW_NAME asc

select v.VIEW_NAME, v.VIEW_TYPE_OWNER, v.VIEW_TYPE, null as COMMENTS, 'N' as IS_SYSTEM_VIEW, o.EDITIONABLE as IS_EDITIONABLE from [PREFIX]_VIEWS v inner join [PREFIX]_OBJECTS o on o.OWNER = v.OWNER and o.OBJECT_NAME = v.VIEW_NAME where v.OWNER = {#0} order by v.VIEW_NAME asc

select v.VIEW_NAME, null as VIEW_TYPE_OWNER, null as VIEW_TYPE, null as COMMENTS, v.ROOT_TABLE_OWNER, v.ROOT_TABlE_NAME, v.JSON_COLUMN_NAME, 'N' as IS_SYSTEM_VIEW, o.EDITIONABLE as IS_EDITIONABLE, DECODE(v.STATUS, 'VALID', 'Y', 'N') as IS_VALID, DECODE(v.READ_ONLY, 'true', 'Y', 'N') as IS_READONLY, DECODE(v.ALLOW_INSERT, 'true', 'Y', 'N') as IS_INSERT_ALLOWED, DECODE(v.ALLOW_UPDATE, 'true', 'Y', 'N') as IS_UPDATE_ALLOWED, DECODE(v.ALLOW_DELETE, 'true', 'Y', 'N') as IS_DELETE_ALLOWED, v.JSON_SCHEMA, listagg(c.JSON_KEY_NAME, ', ') within group (order by c.PRIMARY_KEY_POS) as KEY_ATTRIBUTE_NAMES from [PREFIX]_JSON_DUALITY_VIEWS v, [PREFIX]_JSON_DUALITY_VIEW_TAB_COLS c, [PREFIX]_OBJECTS o where v.VIEW_OWNER = {#0} and c.VIEW_OWNER = v.VIEW_OWNER and c.VIEW_NAME = v.VIEW_NAME and c.root_table = 'true' and c.PRIMARY_KEY_POS is not null and o.OWNER = v.VIEW_OWNER and o.OBJECT_NAME = v.VIEW_NAME group by v.VIEW_NAME, v.ROOT_TABLE_OWNER, v.ROOT_TABlE_NAME, v.JSON_COLUMN_NAME, v.STATUS, v.READ_ONLY, v.ALLOW_INSERT, v.ALLOW_UPDATE, v.ALLOW_DELETE, v.JSON_SCHEMA, o.EDITIONABLE order by v.VIEW_NAME asc

select null as VIEW_NAME, null as VIEW_TYPE_OWNER, null as VIEW_TYPE, null as COMMENTS, null as ROOT_TABLE_OWNER, null as ROOT_TABlE_NAME, null as JSON_COLUMN_NAME, 'N' as IS_SYSTEM_VIEW, 'N' as IS_EDITIONABLE, 'Y' as IS_VALID, 'Y' as IS_READONLY, 'N' as IS_INSERT_ALLOWED, 'N' as IS_UPDATE_ALLOWED, 'N' as IS_DELETE_ALLOWED, null as JSON_SCHEMA, null as KEY_ATTRIBUTE_NAMES from DUAL where 1 = 2
select DBMS_JAVA.GET_JDK_VERSION as VERSION from DUAL

with PRIMITIVES as (select 'boolean,byte,char,double,float,int,long,short,void' as CSV from DUAL) select regexp_substr(CSV, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) as OBJECT_NAME, 'PRIMITIVE' as OBJECT_KIND, 'PUBLIC' as ACCESSIBILITY, null as OUTER_CLASS_NAME, 'Y' as IS_FINAL, 'N' as IS_ABSTRACT, 'N' as IS_INNER, 'N' as IS_STATIC, 'N' as IS_DEBUG, 'Y' as IS_VALID, 'N' as IS_SOURCE, 'Y' as IS_PRIMITIVE from PRIMITIVES connect by level <= regexp_count(CSV, ',') + 1

select j.NAME as OBJECT_NAME, j.KIND as OBJECT_KIND, j.ACCESSIBILITY as ACCESSIBILITY, decode(j.OUTER, '-', null, j.outer) as OUTER_CLASS_NAME, decode(j.IS_FINAL,'YES','Y','N') as IS_FINAL, decode(j.IS_ABSTRACT,'YES','Y','N') as IS_ABSTRACT, decode(j.IS_INNER,'YES','Y','N') as IS_INNER, decode(j.IS_STATIC,'YES','Y','N') as IS_STATIC, decode(j.IS_DEBUG,'YES','Y','N') as IS_DEBUG, decode(o.STATUS, 'VALID', 'Y', 'N') as IS_VALID, decode(os.STATUS, NULL, 'N', 'Y') as IS_SOURCE, 'N' as IS_PRIMITIVE from [PREFIX]_JAVA_CLASSES j left join [PREFIX]_OBJECTS o on o.OWNER = j.OWNER and o.OBJECT_NAME = j.NAME and o.OBJECT_TYPE = 'JAVA CLASS' left join [PREFIX]_OBJECTS os on os.OWNER = j.OWNER and os.OBJECT_NAME = j.NAME and os.OBJECT_TYPE = 'JAVA SOURCE' where j.OWNER = {#0} and j.IS_INNER = 'NO' /* and j.NAME not like '%$%'TODO not all classes containing $ are INNER (!?) */ order by j.NAME
select 1 from dual where 1 = 2

select j.NAME as OBJECT_NAME, j.KIND as OBJECT_KIND, j.ACCESSIBILITY as ACCESSIBILITY, decode(j.OUTER, '-', null, j.outer) as OUTER_CLASS_NAME, decode(j.IS_FINAL,'YES','Y','N') as IS_FINAL, decode(j.IS_ABSTRACT,'YES','Y','N') as IS_ABSTRACT, decode(j.IS_INNER,'YES','Y','N') as IS_INNER, decode(j.IS_STATIC,'YES','Y','N') as IS_STATIC, decode(j.IS_DEBUG,'YES','Y','N') as IS_DEBUG, decode(o.STATUS, 'VALID', 'Y', 'N') as IS_VALID, decode(os.STATUS, NULL, 'N', 'Y') as IS_SOURCE, 'N' as IS_PRIMITIVE from [PREFIX]_JAVA_CLASSES j left join [PREFIX]_OBJECTS o on o.OWNER = j.OWNER and o.OBJECT_NAME = j.NAME and o.OBJECT_TYPE = 'JAVA CLASS' left join [PREFIX]_OBJECTS os on os.OWNER = j.OWNER and os.OBJECT_NAME = j.NAME and os.OBJECT_TYPE = 'JAVA SOURCE' where j.OWNER = {#0} and j.OUTER = {#1} and j.IS_INNER = 'YES' order by j.NAME

select j.NAME as OBJECT_NAME, j.KIND as OBJECT_KIND, j.ACCESSIBILITY as ACCESSIBILITY, decode(j.OUTER, '-', null, j.outer) as OUTER_CLASS_NAME, decode(j.IS_FINAL,'YES','Y','N') as IS_FINAL, decode(j.IS_ABSTRACT,'YES','Y','N') as IS_ABSTRACT, decode(j.IS_INNER,'YES','Y','N') as IS_INNER, decode(j.IS_STATIC,'YES','Y','N') as IS_STATIC, decode(j.IS_DEBUG,'YES','Y','N') as IS_DEBUG, decode(o.STATUS, 'VALID', 'Y', 'N') as IS_VALID, decode(os.STATUS, NULL, 'N', 'Y') as IS_SOURCE, 'N' as IS_PRIMITIVE from [PREFIX]_JAVA_CLASSES j left join [PREFIX]_OBJECTS o on o.OWNER = j.OWNER and o.OBJECT_NAME = j.NAME and o.OBJECT_TYPE = 'JAVA CLASS' left join [PREFIX]_OBJECTS os on os.OWNER = j.OWNER and os.OBJECT_NAME = j.NAME and os.OBJECT_TYPE = 'JAVA SOURCE' where j.OWNER = {#0} and j.IS_INNER = 'YES' order by j.NAME

select NAME as OWNER_CLASS_NAME, FIELD_INDEX, FIELD_NAME, ACCESSIBILITY, decode(IS_FINAL,'YES','Y','N') as IS_FINAL, decode(IS_STATIC,'YES','Y','N') as IS_STATIC, ARRAY_DEPTH, decode(FIELD_CLASS, '-', BASE_TYPE, FIELD_CLASS) as FIELD_CLASS_NAME from [PREFIX]_JAVA_FIELDS where OWNER = {#0} and NAME = {#1} and BASE_TYPE is not null order by FIELD_INDEX

select NAME as OWNER_CLASS_NAME, FIELD_INDEX, FIELD_NAME, ACCESSIBILITY, decode(IS_FINAL,'YES','Y','N') as IS_FINAL, decode(IS_STATIC,'YES','Y','N') as IS_STATIC, ARRAY_DEPTH, decode(FIELD_CLASS, '-', BASE_TYPE, FIELD_CLASS) as FIELD_CLASS_NAME from [PREFIX]_JAVA_FIELDS where OWNER = {#0} and BASE_TYPE is not null order by NAME, FIELD_INDEX

select m.NAME as OWNER_CLASS_NAME, m.METHOD_NAME||'#'||m.METHOD_INDEX as METHOD_NAME, m.METHOD_INDEX, m.ACCESSIBILITY, m.ARRAY_DEPTH, decode(m.RETURN_CLASS, '-', m.BASE_TYPE, m.RETURN_CLASS) as RETURN_CLASS_NAME, decode(m.IS_STATIC,'YES','Y','N') as IS_STATIC, decode(m.IS_FINAL,'YES','Y','N') as IS_FINAL, decode(m.IS_ABSTRACT,'YES','Y','N') as IS_ABSTRACT, case when m.METHOD_NAME = chr(60)||'init'||chr(62) then regexp_substr(m.NAME, '[^/]+$', 1, 1) else m.METHOD_NAME end || '(' || listagg(decode(a.ARGUMENT_CLASS, '-', a.BASE_TYPE, regexp_substr(a.ARGUMENT_CLASS, '[^/]+$', 1, 1))|| lpad('[]', a.ARRAY_DEPTH * 2, '[]'), ', ') within group (order by a.ARGUMENT_POSITION) || '): ' || decode(m.RETURN_CLASS, '-', m.BASE_TYPE, regexp_substr(m.RETURN_CLASS, '[^/]+$', 1, 1)) || lpad('[]', m.ARRAY_DEPTH * 2, '[]') as METHOD_SIGNATURE from [PREFIX]_JAVA_METHODS m left join [PREFIX]_JAVA_ARGUMENTS a on m.OWNER = a.OWNER and m.NAME = a.NAME and m.METHOD_INDEX = a.METHOD_INDEX where m.OWNER = {#0} and m.NAME = {#1} and m.METHOD_NAME != '-' and m.METHOD_NAME != chr(60)||'clinit'||chr(62) group by m.NAME, m.METHOD_NAME, m.METHOD_INDEX, m.BASE_TYPE, m.ACCESSIBILITY, m.RETURN_CLASS, m.ARRAY_DEPTH, m.IS_STATIC, m.IS_FINAL, m.IS_ABSTRACT order by m.METHOD_NAME, m.METHOD_INDEX

select m.NAME as OWNER_CLASS_NAME, m.METHOD_NAME||'#'||m.METHOD_INDEX as METHOD_NAME, m.METHOD_INDEX, m.ACCESSIBILITY, m.ARRAY_DEPTH, decode(m.RETURN_CLASS, '-', m.BASE_TYPE, m.RETURN_CLASS) as RETURN_CLASS_NAME, decode(m.IS_STATIC,'YES','Y','N') as IS_STATIC, decode(m.IS_FINAL,'YES','Y','N') as IS_FINAL, decode(m.IS_ABSTRACT,'YES','Y','N') as IS_ABSTRACT, case when m.METHOD_NAME = chr(60)||'init'||chr(62) then regexp_substr(m.NAME, '[^/]+$', 1, 1) else m.METHOD_NAME end || '(' || listagg(decode(a.ARGUMENT_CLASS, '-', a.BASE_TYPE, regexp_substr(a.ARGUMENT_CLASS, '[^/]+$', 1, 1))|| lpad('[]', a.ARRAY_DEPTH * 2, '[]'), ', ') within group (order by a.ARGUMENT_POSITION) || '): ' || decode(m.RETURN_CLASS, '-', m.BASE_TYPE, regexp_substr(m.RETURN_CLASS, '[^/]+$', 1, 1)) || lpad('[]', m.ARRAY_DEPTH * 2, '[]') as METHOD_SIGNATURE from [PREFIX]_JAVA_METHODS m left join [PREFIX]_JAVA_ARGUMENTS a on m.OWNER = a.OWNER and m.NAME = a.NAME and m.METHOD_INDEX = a.METHOD_INDEX where m.OWNER = {#0} and m.METHOD_NAME != '-' and m.METHOD_NAME != chr(60)||'clinit'||chr(62) group by m.NAME, m.METHOD_NAME, m.METHOD_INDEX, m.BASE_TYPE, m.ACCESSIBILITY, m.RETURN_CLASS, m.ARRAY_DEPTH, m.IS_STATIC, m.IS_FINAL, m.IS_ABSTRACT order by m.NAME, m.METHOD_NAME, m.METHOD_INDEX

select NAME as CLASS_NAME, METHOD_NAME||'#'||METHOD_INDEX as METHOD_NAME, METHOD_INDEX, ARGUMENT_POSITION, ARRAY_DEPTH, decode(ARGUMENT_CLASS, '-', BASE_TYPE, ARGUMENT_CLASS) as ARGUMENT_CLASS_NAME from [PREFIX]_JAVA_ARGUMENTS where OWNER = {#0} and NAME = {#1} and METHOD_NAME = SUBSTR({#2}, 1, INSTR({#2}, '#') - 1) and METHOD_INDEX = SUBSTR({#3}, INSTR({#3}, '#') + 1) order by ARGUMENT_POSITION

select NAME as CLASS_NAME, METHOD_NAME||'#'||METHOD_INDEX as METHOD_NAME, METHOD_INDEX, ARGUMENT_POSITION, ARRAY_DEPTH, decode(ARGUMENT_CLASS, '-', BASE_TYPE, ARGUMENT_CLASS) as ARGUMENT_CLASS_NAME from [PREFIX]_JAVA_ARGUMENTS where OWNER = {#0} order by NAME, METHOD_NAME, METHOD_INDEX, ARGUMENT_POSITION

select d.OBJECT_OWNER, d.OBJECT_NAME, case when s.OWNER is not null then 'Y' else 'N' end as HAS_SOURCE from ( select distinct REFERENCED_OWNER as OBJECT_OWNER, REFERENCED_NAME as OBJECT_NAME from [PREFIX]_DEPENDENCIES where REFERENCED_TYPE = 'JAVA CLASS' and REFERENCED_OWNER != 'SYS' and (OWNER != REFERENCED_OWNER or NAME != REFERENCED_NAME) start with OWNER = {#0} and NAME = {#1} connect by nocycle prior REFERENCED_OWNER = OWNER and prior REFERENCED_NAME = NAME ) d inner join [PREFIX]_JAVA_CLASSES c on c.OWNER = d.OBJECT_OWNER and c.NAME = d.OBJECT_NAME and c.IS_INNER = 'NO' left join [PREFIX]_SOURCE s on s.OWNER = d.OBJECT_OWNER and s.NAME = d.OBJECT_NAME and s.LINE = 1 order by HAS_SOURCE desc, d.OBJECT_OWNER, d.OBJECT_NAME
select OBJECT_NAME, decode(STATUS, 'VALID', 'Y', 'N') as IS_VALID from [PREFIX]_OBJECTS where OWNER = {#0} and OBJECT_TYPE = 'JAVA RESOURCE' order by OBJECT_NAME
